overall_rationale: Overall not_feasible, driven by two must needs. N3 (hourly temperature and humidity) is partially met for the production window: Open-Meteo gives temperature only and no candidate supplies relative humidity for 2024-2025, so no candidate closes the gap. N2 (hourly traffic near the stations) is partially met: the only traffic source covers production, but counter-to-station proximity is unverified and the 2024-03-18 counting change is undocumented in the catalog. N1 is met with conditions: uci_360 covers the prototype window and internal.airq.station_readings covers production, conditional on access and on confirming station status. N4 (should) is met with conditions via the clinic daily counts. N5 is out of scope by brief, and N6 (could) is unmet with its source not_feasible. The Chicago link is not_feasible: it is unreachable, unlicensed and outside IT. The humidity gap for production would need a register change that is not yet verified, so the overall verdict stays not_feasible until that is resolved.
